The adoption of the parallel transistors and a resonance inductor in parallel with the series transistors is to improve the isolation of the SPDT switch. Ordering the sequence of bits is optimized so as to minimize the overall return and insertion loss. The proposed phase shifter, with a chip size of 4.2mm*2.2mm, exhibits better than 10dB return loss, no more than 7.6 dB insertion loss, better than 3.3° RMS phase error and 0.7dB RMS amplitude error over the operating frequency range.

articleTitle: Intelligent Cost Estimation Method for Large-Scale Projects Based on PCA Optimized RBF Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, we break down the large-scale project into small units so that we can extract the parameters that relates most to the total cost more easily. However, the amount of these parameters are huge, causing much trouble for RBF neural fitting, so we need to reduce the number of these parameters by using PCA. Then we put the newly generated parameters as the inputs of RBF neural networks. The results of the empirical analysis showed a sound verification that the proposed cost estimation method is worthy of expanding.

articleTitle: Research on Movie Box Office Forecasting Based on Internet Data
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The film industry is one of the fastest growing industries in the world, especially the growth of Chinese movie box office. Now the film industry is still a high risk industry. As a capital intensive industry, movie box office forecasting is particularly important to investment and financing of the film, cinema advertising sales, row of film theaters, marketing, operations and various aspects. Based on the traditional data of the film, this paper adds the new media data of Internet to predict the movie box office. Our model involves 16 variables integrated as 5 aspects - film's transmission capacity, publicity of the film, film marketing efforts, basic attributes of the film, film creators. With the application of BP neural network, the forecast accuracy can reach 72% one month before film release.

articleTitle: Study of Digital Modulation Signal Error Vector Magnitude Based on Vector Signal Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this article, based on the working principle of vector signal analyzer and theories of error vector magnitude (EVM), Combined signal demodulation experiment of vector signal analyzer, converting some types of digital modulation signal EVM into root mean square of error vector magnitude(EVMRMS). According to the relationship between EVMRMS and bit error rate(BER), analyzing the relationship between vector signal analyzer EVM and BER, and the simulation results are carried out.

articleTitle: Algorithm of Speed-Up Turnout Indication Circuit Fault Intelligent Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Since the railway Communication and Signal Department have no effective means of automatic fault diagnosis for the speed-up turnout indication circuit, this paper summarized typical values and the cause of the malfunction by the test when the speed-up turnout indication circuit was open circuit fault, then used the BP neural network algorithm to train and test the feature vectors and mapping sample set representing the open circuit fault. Experimental results show that the fault diagnosis algorithm of the speed-up turnout indication circuit has characteristics of high accuracy, good effect, can effectively compress the such a fault delay.

articleTitle: Real-Time Multi-objective Optimal Control Algorithm for Greenhouse Environment Using Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The problem of greenhouse climate control has traditionally been solved by using experience based method or model based method, Moreover, light and CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> are seldom used in greenhouse environment control to make sure that environment state is the essential of high crop production. This paper presents a multi-objective economic optimization problem in greenhouse climate control solved in real time using a method, real-time multi-objective optimal control algorithm (MOOCA), proposed in this paper. Photosynthesis, which rate is determined by current environment (light intensity, CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> concentration and temperature), plays a key role on crop growth. Light compensation and CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> compensation are used to improve the photosynthesis rate so as to increase the crop yield. Optimization algorithm using a modified Multi-objective Particle Swarm Optimization weighs the crop yield and energy cost and gives control decision. Simulation results show the profit of real-time optimization and freedom of choice farmers make to meet their benefit demands.

articleTitle: A Research on the Compatibility Principles of Formulas for Spleen and Stomach Health from Thousand Golden Prescriptions Based on Clustering Mining and Association Rule Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: As the earliest clinical medical encyclopedia ever found in China, Thousand Golden Prescriptions describes a great many health preserving formulas of the traditional Chinese medicine (TCM). From TCM's point of view, many symptoms are correlated, and hence the corresponding curative formulas are also correlated. It is much scientific and subjective to do research about correlation of herbs from the aspect of attribution of herbs such as character, taste and its function by using the method of clustering mining. This paper screens and collates the spleen & stomach health preserving formulas from Thousand Golden Prescriptions to develop a formula database containing such fields as herb, formula name and indication, so as to analyze herb application frequency and carry out the mining of herb-application association rules, herb-classification association rules and clustering mining. This paper leverages the data mining approach to discuss the herb application rules of spleen & stomach health preserving formulas from multiple perspectives, and eventually obtains the commonly-used herb groups and herb pairs through association rule mining which have been confirmed by pharmacology experts. This study draws to a conclusion that the compatibility rules of the spleen & stomach health preserving formulas as described in Thousand Golden Prescriptions can be discovered by applying data mining.

articleTitle: Research on the Service Platform to Realize Unified Retrieval and Revelation of Digital Cultural Resources
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to realize the combination of traditional culture industry with digital technology, network technology and information technology. We design a distributed, scalable, interoperable service platform to realize unified retrieval and revelation of digital cultural resources. The platform can realize the unified retrieval and revelation of books, periodicals, pictures, audio, video, drama, dance, tourism and other more than ten kinds of digital cultural resources and has formed a distributed seamless cross database service system includes ten million metadata and one million object data.

articleTitle: Motion Retrieval Based on Dynamic Bayesian Network and Canonical Time Warping
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A novel graph-based motion retrieval method is proposed. The method includes the 2 main stages: (1) in stage of learning, firstly, for each of motion in database, using Aligned Cluster Analysis (ACA) to get key frames, extracting body gesture and joint state features as observation signal of graph model, based on graph model theory and statistical learning of key frame, a new Dynamic Bayesian Network (DBN) frame is constructed. The graph-based motion descriptor is built based on DBN inference, and graph-based motion feature database is constructed. (2) In stage of motion retrieval, we can recognize category of motion through Canonical Time Warping(CTW) matching results.

articleTitle: Utility Pattern Mining Algorithm Based on Improved Utility Pattern Tree
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: UP-Growth is one of the most discussed high utility pattern mining algorithms based on the data structure of UP-Tree. However, the process of construction trees needs to scan database several times and spends much time in calculating. To solve these problems, an improved construction process of UP-Tree is proposed by introducing a Fast Utility Tree (FU-Tree). In this method, we introduce the LinkQueue to reduce the number of scanning the original database and adopt prefix utility to minimize the overestimated utility. The theoretical analyses and experimental results show that FU-Tree outperforms UP-Tree in the time consumption of construction trees, and enhances the efficiency of mining high utility itemsets.

articleTitle: Research on the Configuration Design Method of the Product Based on the Extension Case-Based Reasoning
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This article relates to the configuration design method of the product based on the extension case-based reasoning for transferring the demanding information into expected matter element so as to implement the mapping relationship between the customer needs and the configuration structures, to implement the mapping relationship between the configuration structures and configuration modules by relationship matter element reasoning, to get a group of module case that can satisfy the requirements of the customers from the configuration module library, and to realize the initial conceptual design. Take a complex system as an example to verify the feasibility of the configuration design method of the product.

articleTitle: Fault Prediction for Power Plant Equipment Based on Support Vector Regression
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: To provide effective fault prediction on power plant equipment, a method of fault prediction based on support vector regression is proposed in this paper. First, we calculate the correlation coefficient to select proper features to form the feature vector, Then we use the grid search method to optimize the two important parameters of support vector regression, Finally, we establish the prediction model with the feature vector and the optimized parameters obtained above to predict expected values of corresponding data items of the equipment. The analysis of one day data of coal mill of a measurement point A1 shows that, compared with the method without optimization, the root mean square error (RMSE), mean absolute error (MAE) and mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of this method have significantly reduced. This result indicates that: the model established by this method is able to predict the value of measurement points more accurately with superior generalization ability, and can be applied in the field of fault prediction.

articleTitle: Research on Spectrum Allocation of HF Access Network Based on Intelligent Frequency Hopping
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: By directing at the problem that the existing fixed spectrum allocation method of HF access network cannot satisfy the new requirement of applying intelligent frequency hopping technology, the spectrum demand of intelligent frequency hopping HF access network is analyzed, and a spectrum allocation model based on graph coloring theory is established for the spectrum allocation issue of HF access network users. Besides, spectrum allocation algorithm applicable to intelligent frequency hopping HF access network is proposed. According to the simulation results, this method can effectively solve application problems of intelligent frequency hopping technology in HF access network, and meanwhile quickly, efficiently and accurately complete allocation of usable spectrums, compared with fixed frequency communication of using fixed spectrum allocation method, intelligent frequency hopping of adopting this method can obviously increase subnet reachability and network throughput of HF access network.

articleTitle: Research of Anti-Interference Technology Based on Magnetic Field Variation of Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The vehicle detector induces a magnetic field variation around the vehicle to decide the vehicle status. However, the three-way relationship among the axial direction of vehicle detector, the parking direction and the magnetic field direction will result in great interference for detection sensitivity. In order to solve the low sensitivity caused by three-way angle such as the interference caused by near vehicle, this study analyzes the fundamental relationship among these three angles and establish a vehicle detection model to reduce the interference based on the principle of pace magnetic field. And then test every axial direction of the 2-Axis magnetic vehicle detector by parking the near vehicle in different directions. By doing this, the writer can draw the conclusion of how to make the principle axis output a peak value of sensitivity and the secondary axis a low peak value of sensitivity, thus to improve detection sensitivity and reduce the interference of adjacent space. In this way, the data which shows the relationship between angle and interference will help companies in Taicang, Jiangsu to obtain good economic benefits.

articleTitle: Research on Gait Planning and Inverse Kinematics Solving of Biped Walking Robots
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Gait planning and inverse kinematics are becoming more complex with the development of biped walking robots. In this paper we propose a new method to simplify these processes. By applying this method, the angle variation based on the walking pose at each moment can be figured out simultaneously and straightforward without complex calculations. The method starts from a linear inverted pendulum model in three-dimensional Cartesian coordinates which is used for planning the centroid and the walking pose of the robot. Then the kinematics equations in each discrete joint are established to obtain the trajectory of each joint, followed by adopting the space vector angle to solve the robot's inverse kinematics. We finally establish a simulation model of the biped robot using Matlab to test the validity of our method. The results indicate that stable walking and simplified inverse kinematics solving can be realized using our method.

articleTitle: Principal Component Analysis for Clustering Temporomandibular Joint Data
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Temporomandibular joint disorders are the second most common cause of orofacial pain. The replacement of symptomatic, degenerative temporomandibular joint is attracting increasing attention. It is important that any surgical implants has the correct dimensions to fit its intended site. Cluster analysis is a method to determine the size ranges for temporomandibular joint replacement prosthesis. In this study, the knowledge-based K-means clustering method was proposed. Principal component analysis is a classical technique to reduce the dimensionality of the data set by transforming to a new set of variables to summarize the features of the data. In our paper, we study the effectiveness of principal components in capturing cluster structure. Specifically, we compare the quality of clusters obtained from the original data to the quality of clusters obtained after projecting onto subsets of the principal component axes. Our study shows that clustering with the principal component instead of the original variables will improve the cluster quality. Overall, we would recommend principal component analysis before clustering in Euclidean space.

articleTitle: Office Software Control System for Kinect
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper studies the recognition of body gesture to achieve human-computer interaction, which defined by physical methods and algorithms matching body gesture to achieve recognition. Physical definition mainly for skeletal point of the relative coordinates define the size of the operation, the matching algorithm used quaternion main points of the characteristic features of bone extraction operation, with better flexible, fast, accurate and robust. We need to establish the action database before the algorithm for matching, We first establish a model library by the extraction of BVH files, and then we should get the 3D position of 15 body joints based on quaternion features, and its characteristic normalized, and make its characteristic normalized to establish a model database, and then use DTW (dynamic time warping) algorithm matches the characteristics of the action under test data and the data in the database, which the nearest distance is what we want to detect motion. Interactive system can be used for office software control, to make teaching more intelligent.

articleTitle: A Novel Detection Method Based on Generalized Keystone Transform and RFT for High-Speed Maneuvering Target
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The coherent integration problem for a space moving target with high-speed maneuvering performance is considered in this paper. The radial velocity, acceleration and jerk of the maneuvering target would result in the first-order range migration (FRM), second-order range migration (SRM) and third-order range migration (TRM) respectively within the coherent integration time. This paper proposes a novel long time coherent integration method based on generalized keystone transform (GKT) and Radon Fourier transform (RFT). Firstly, third-order and six-order keystone transform are used to correct TRM and SRM, respectively and the improved de-chirping method is utilized to compensate for the Doppler spread (DS). Then, residual range migration (RM) will be corrected by RFT. This algorithm can correct RM without knowing its motion information. The advantage of the proposed approach is that it can achieve the coherent integration under the condition of Doppler frequency ambiguity. The computational burden of the proposed method is less than that of GRFT algorithm. Finally, simulations are performed to demonstrate the validity of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Real-Time Artistic Silhouettes Rendering for 3D Models
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In line drawings, the line thickness is an important element for artists to depict shape and express emotion. In this paper, we proposed an approach for the real-time rendering of artistic silhouette outlines, based on the inherent aesthetic law of line thickness. We adopted the triangle shell technique as the basis of our silhouette outlines rendering method. By shifting the vertex of the back-facing mesh along its vertex normal under the aesthetic law, we recovered the variation of line thickness that artists often use when creating line drawings, and obtained aesthetically pleasing rendering results. Our method is implemented on GPU, and is suitable for real-time applications such as 3D games.

articleTitle: Based on SO-PMI Algorithm to Discriminate Sentimental Words' Polarity in TV Programs' Subjective Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the increasing of comment data about television programs on Internet, using text mining technology to analyze the massive data so that it can make subjective evaluation about television programs. It can give decision support and improve competitiveness for each department in radio and TV industry. This paper mainly introduces how to using sentiment-oriented pointwise mutual information (SO-PMI) to judge sentimental words' polarity and calculate sentimental words' intensity. It lays a solid foundation for the further study of subjective evaluation about television programs.

articleTitle: The Research and Implementation of Urban Pollution Sources Information Management System Based on ArcGIS Server Web ADF
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A information management system was designed and implemented based on the ArcGIS Server Web ADF. The system is a WebGIS with three-tier B/S structure. It realizes the integrated storage and management of spatial data and attributes data, and the share, analysis and visualization of spatial information. The paper introduced the system structure and function design, and described the method of constructing database, the method of asynchronous updating client data using the callback mechanism, locally and dynamically updating method of the ArcGIS Server map cache, and online editing method of spatial data based on the Web ADF JavaScript Library in detail. The paper provides a reference for urban environmental protection departments to develop similar pollution source management information system.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Learning Part-Based Representation for Stocks Market Prediction
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Machine learning has been extensively studied for its potentials in prediction of financial markets. Popular predicting models, such as logistic regression, are quite effective in predicting the trend of a stock. A robust classifier can maximize the profit of stock purchase while keep the risk low. In this paper, we present a theoretical and empirical framework to apply L2-regularized logistic regression to predict the stock market. Firstly, we select ten factors that may influence the stock trend, and use logistics regression to model the relationship of these factors and the quality of stocks. Instead of directly using logistic regression on the original data, we firstly used NMF to unsupervised learn part-based representations of the data, and then a classifier is trained on those representations. Our experimental results suggest that logistic regression with part-based representation of data is a powerful predictive tool for stock predictions in the financial market.

articleTitle: An Interior Point Source Localization Algorithm in Multi-agent Systems
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper considers the constrained least squares (CLS) approach for source localization problem based on range-difference (RD) measurements collected from a multi-agent system. We provide an interior point algorithm for efficiently computing the CLS estimate of the source position by analyzing the special structure of the corresponding optimization problem. Numerical simulations suggest that the proposed algorithm is much more efficient than the Lagrange multiplier algorithm as well as the Matlab toolbox CVX.

articleTitle: Online Object Tracking and Learning with Sparse Deformable Template Models
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Object tracking is an important and challenging task in the field of computer vision. The objective of object tracking is to associate target objects in consecutive video frames. In this paper, we use SVM trained active basis model as a sparse deformable template for representing objects. Active basis model is a sparse model, which represents each image as a small number of bases selected from an over-complete Gabor dictionary. Given the bounding box of the object in the first frame, the model can be trained on the positive image patch inside the bounding box and negative images outside the bounding box. The tracking is achieved by detection of the object in the subsequent frames in the video by using the learned model. The model will be updated after a few of frames by using new positive and negative images, which are specified by the model. The experiment shows a good performance of the tracking method in some testing videos.

articleTitle: A Mission-Oriented Simulating and Optimizing Method for Information Flow of Ship System
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: For the design of ship information system is still based on the functional integration and difficult to promote overall ship's information exchange and disposal efficiency, a mission-oriented simulating and optimizing method for ship system information flow is proposed. Based on resolving total ship's mission and relating fight node, the information flow model of ship system is established through adopting the technology of DoDAF architecture view. The simulation results have shown that this method could be not only applicable to check the veracity and rationality of information flow, but also to evaluate the key node and perform efficiency of information exchange model, so it is an availability technology method of quantitative analysis to validate and optimize the scheme of ship informatization.

articleTitle: Research of Force Requirement Model with the Organizational System of the Army Based on Warfighting Capability Index
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Through analysis of the shortcomings of traditional force requirement model and taking into full account of soldiers' great contribution to the enhancement of army operational ability, this paper puts forward a warfighting capability index-based force calculation method, abandoning the force requirement ideas stressing only the weapon and equipment. It then introduces the Lanchester Equation, determines the criteria of winning battle, and acquires warfighting capability index required with the said index replacing the number of soldiers. Finally, through analysis of warfighting capability index, it achieves the force requirement model and algorithm with the organizational system of the army.

articleTitle: Portfolio Selection Strategies with Investor Psychology and Behavior under Fuzzy Random Environment
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Future return rate is affected by both of the subjective factors and objective factors. So fuzzy and random uncertainty are considered in portfolio selection problems simultaneously. By using fuzzy random variable to measure future return rate, a novel fuzzy random portfolio selection model with investor psychology and behavior is proposed. The model provide different investment strategies for different investors with different rational-emotional, optimistic-pessimistic and risk preference attitudes. Finally, a numerical example is put forward to illustrate the efficiency of the model.

articleTitle: The Fuzzy Efficiency Evaluation Method for XML Quadratic Blowup Attack
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Aimed at the attack principle and features of XML quadratic blowup attack, the fuzzy evaluation method has been studied to evaluate the attack efficiency in this paper. The main procedures of the fuzzy evaluation method include choosing efficiency evaluation indexes, determining attack result set, and establishing fuzzy membership function. According to the fuzzy membership function, membership matrixes can be obtained by calculating, and index weights can be determined by judgment matrix method, which is one kind of the subjective assignment method. Finally, the fuzzy synthesis evaluation is carried out. Based on established evaluation model, sample data is collected and instance verification is conducted. The result shows that fuzzy evaluation method can evaluate the efficiency of network attacks scientifically and effectively.

articleTitle: Multi-resolution Community Discovery from Signed Networks Based on Novel Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: There commonly exist friendly and hostile relation-ships between the individuals in the social networks. The signed network modeling of the social network is one of the effective tool for analyzing the properties of social networks. Recent years, community feature has been proved to be an important property of complex networks. To discover the community structure from signed social networks is of great importance to promote the harmonious development of the society. The task of community discovery from signed networks was modeled as an optimization problem, a novel particle swarm optimization algorithm was proposed to solve the modeled problem. The algorithm optimized a newly suggested objective function called signed link density, which takes a control parameter. By alerting the parameter, the algorithm could obtain the community structures of a network under different resolutions. In order to enhance the global optimization ability of the particle swarm optimization algorithm, a neighborhood dominance based local search operator was designed. To check the performance of the proposed algorithm, experiments on synthetic and real-world signed networks had been carried out, and comparisons with a method existed in the literature had been made. The experiments have demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimizing NPV of Projects under Cash Constraint by Modified ACO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Considering the condition that cash and time are constrained, and the general background of growing financing cost, aiming at maximizing the net present value (NPV), an optimizing model for this kind of problem is established. Ant colony optimization is modified to solve above problem, an elitist strategy is introduced to accelerate convergence. A specific example of this problem is utilized to validate above model and its algorithm. It indicates from the result that the model can provide a dispatch strategy of the project, the algorithm provide a satisfactory solution for the problem. The convergence of the algorithm is relatively good and it can be used to solve practical problems.

articleTitle: Log-Spectral Linear Regression Based on Voicing Cut-Off Frequency for Robust Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper proposes a maximum likelihood log-spectral linear regression algorithm based on voicing cut-off frequency for robust speech recognition, which converts the pre-trained acoustic model to the log-spectral domain by the inverse discrete cosine transform and ignores the high-frequency part of the training mean and variance. Then the testing mean and variance are obtained by the log-spectral linear regression and the linear regression parameters are estimated from small amounts of adaptive data using the expectation -- maximization algorithm under the maximum likelihood criterion. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can obtain more accurate testing acoustic models and outperforms the traditional linear regression method.

articleTitle: Design for the Parameters' Transfer of A Hybrid Real-Time Communication Network in TD-LTE
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In TD-LTE test verification system, a proper method is needed for the parameters' transfer, which is based on software and hardware co-simulation platform. In this paper, the hybrid Real-Time communication network, which is composed of TCP/IP protocol, UDP protocol and reflective memory technology on account of hardware board, was built and a loopback test system between system simulation and link system for parameters' interface has been formed. The entire system has realized the sending and receiving of the parameters, which is fast, scalable and flexible link by either the optical fibers or LAN cable. Results show that the latency of the data could prove the key microsecond-level delay. That not only ensures the complex Real-Time of communication system, but also does not lose the parameters' information of the whole system.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Mining Influential Nodes and Hidden Valuable Relationships in Generic Flow Networks
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Identifying influential nodes is largely studied for its widely application in various fields. However, the previous studies usually concentrate on the undirected weighted networks or binary networks, neglecting the orientation information, which is vital for flow networks. Although some key nodes discovery algorithms based on the basic idea of PageRank are proposed to analyze nodes centrality in directed weighted networks, these methods can not be applied to the generic flow networks directly. At the same time, original research gives no answer to the exact interplay among nodes, which may help us to dig out hidden valuable relationships in the networks. In this paper, we put forward a novel algorithm to recognize the important nodes and invisible influential connections based on the notion of random walk. The total flow but not the direct flow in the networks should be considered to evaluate the impact of nodes. Finally, applying this method to a clickstream network, we find it do give a better rankings on websites than PageRank algorithm and helpful to excavate the websites' hidden "visitors providers". This method provides a network flow analysis frame work and may be meaningful to many research fields like epidemic diffusion, traffic flow analysis, implied lexical meaning mining and so on.

articleTitle: The Tibetan Microblog Text Representation Method Based on Shallow Parsing
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Tibetan text representation, which has great influence on Tibetan text Categorization and Cluster, is the groundwork in Tibetan text mining. Tibetan microblog is one of the most popular Tibetan network media. Researches on Tibetan microblog are now increasing. However, because of the special features of microblog text and the features of Tibetan language, traditional Tibetan text representation method cannot satisfy the need. This paper proposes a Tibetan microblog text representation method that is based on shallow parsing and takes the Tibetan micro-blog sentiment analysis experiment. First, for Tibetan micro-blog text, the syntactic structure is generated by using syntactic tree. Second, the semantic feature space is built based on syntactic structures semantic features. Then, the semantic Cluster centroid is formed with the K-means method in the feature space. Last, the TF-IDF value based on cluster is calculated. The experiment shows, the method of this paper is compared with the SVM+TF-IDF and Naive Bayes+ the Maximum Entropy method, the F-measure is as high as 91.4%.

articleTitle: Application of Field Bus Technology Based on ZigBee in Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With energy and environmental issues become increasingly prominent, development of clean energy has become an important strategy for sustainable development of economy and society. Microgrid has the characteristics of effective utilization, flexible and intelligent control for distributed generation, which is becoming a hot spot. Real-time requirements for implementation of microgrid control and data acquisition control strategy are very high, so from communication control architecture to solve the core problem, improve microgrid stability and fast response. In this paper, field bus technology based on ZigBee network is applied in AC/DC hybrid microgrid, can not only realize microgrid real time control requirements, and has the function of remote control, autonomous operation, data acquisition and storage.

articleTitle: Research on Small Scale Wind Streak Factor of Navigation Radar-Image Sequences
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The modulation of wind leads to a strip distribution of the ocean surface roughness. There always exist small scale wind streak in the navigation radar image. This paper investigates the radar imaging theory of wind modulation procedure, the small scale wind streak image have been extracted through low-past filter using the measured data, the scale and period of the wind streak can be determined simultaneously. The results show that the real wind modulation images coincide with our theory assumption. Finally, we find the lower limit of small scale wind streak is 200m, the lifetime is approximately more than ten minutes.

articleTitle: Self-Assembly Method for Cooperation of Multi-satellites
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: To cooperate different satellites in the complexity multi-satellite systems, this paper introduces the idea of self-assembly which is one of the basic mechanisms in the supramolecular chemistry. The multi-satellite systems is modeled by a half-edge graph model and its assembly growing method is proposed to automatically assemble resources for some mission. Finally, the simulation results of the resource assignment for the spaceflight mission by the proposed method show that the self-assembly method shed some light on the cooperation of multi-satellites.

articleTitle: The Novel Design Method of Hardware Trojans
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, according to the obfuscation design idea of hardware protection, we present a hardware Trojans generating method based on obfuscation design. We take the AES algorithm as the target circuits and compare the impacts of the Hardware Trojans circuits after the obfuscation design on the area, power and timing-delay with the original circuits, and achieve to increase the difficult of functional verification and logic detection.

articleTitle: Compact Stepped Monopole ACS-Fed Antenna for Tri-Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A compact planar triple-band stepped monopole antenna is presented. This asymmetric coplanar strip (ACS)-fed structure with single lateral ground plane is used to reduce the oversize of antenna, a single stepped monopole is designed to realize dual band frequencies operating, a Γ-shaped trip connecting the signal trip with the ground plane offers a more flexible and stronger coupling, an I-shaped stub inverted to the ground is employed to turn the impedance matching effectively, then a snake-shaped slot inserting on the ground plane is applied to launch a new frequency. The proposed antenna, with a very compact size of 21.65×12 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, generates three desired resonant frequencies at about 2.4 (2.38-2.51), 3.5 (3.31- 3.58), 5.4 (5.14-5.65) GHz for WLAN and WiMAX applications. This antenna presents high bands isolation and good pass-band performance.

articleTitle: Region Covariance for Deformation Measurement of Non-rigid Biological Tissues from MR Images
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an integrated method SRC (SIFT and Region Covariance) for feature point matching in MR images of nonlinear and nonuniform deformation of nonrigid tissues. First, from the template and deformed images, the DoG detector and SIFT descriptor are used to extract and describe the feature points. Then use the covariance of neighborhood feature statistics computed inside a region of interest as the region descriptor. Finally, use a nearest neighbor search algorithm using a distance metric defined on the positive definite symmetric matrices for feature matching. The experimental results showed that the proposed SRC method outperformed the single SURF and SIFT methods.

articleTitle: Model Identification and Control Strategies for Batch Cooling Crystallizers
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The study of an optimal cooling control strategy for a batch white sugar crystallization process is reported in this paper. Within the proposed control strategy, a dynamic optimization algorithm (DOA) and a generic model control (GMC) algorithm were compared with respect to the final process quality achieved. The linear models required in the controller structures were extracted applying two identification alternatives. The GMC algorithm cases seem to guarantee more satisfactory end point quality of the process. However, only the DOA of the supersaturation manipulating the steam flowrate makes feasible all conflicting control objectives.

articleTitle: An Estimation Method of Direct Spread Signal Pseudo-Code Rate Based on Delay-and-Multiplication Autocorrelation
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to solve parameter estimation problem of Direct spread signal (DS signal) pseudo-code rate in low SNR, the generation mechanism of DS signal and autocorrelation characteristics are deeply studied. The received DS signal is processed by follows, such as delay-and-multiply, autocorrelation, low-pass filtering and fast fourier transform, which reduce noise interference. Finally the effective estimation of pseudo-code rate can be realized by searching for the pseudo-code rate spectral lines. Finally by searching for pseudo-code rate spectral lines method can realize the effective estimation of pseudo-code rate. In the case of SNR is -16dB, Simulation results show that the method can realize effective estimation of the pseudo-code rate parameters. And effective estimation of pseudo-code rate in lower SNR can be realized by increasing the processing data points.

articleTitle: Multiple Kernel Sparse Representation Based Gaussian Kernel and Power Kernel
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Sparse representation classification (SRC) and kernel method have been successfully used in pattern recognition. On account of the limitations of the single kernel function, we proposed multiple kernel sparse classification method in face recognition to improve human face recognition rate. The Power kernel function has a good stability, and the Gaussian kernel function has good practicability. The Power kernel function and Gaussian kernel function are linearly combined. Through the transformation of different kernel space, we effectively extract the nonlinear structure information of the human face. Many experimental results show that the multiple kernel sparse representation classification algorithms that based on Power kernel function and Gaussian kernel function have higher recognition rate than that only using the single kernel sparse representation classification.

articleTitle: The Hybrid TS-SS Algorithm for Vehicle Routing Problem with Simultaneous Delivery and Pick-Up
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Basing on the idea of green logistics, first, this paper discusses on the Vehicle Routing Problem with Simultaneous Delivery and Pick-up and its mathematical formulation, second, On the basis of it, Hybrid Tabu search algorithm with scatter search algorithm (TS & SS) is to solve simultaneous delivery and pick-up (VRPSDP). Considering the quality and dispersity of solution in the solution process, dynamic tabu mechanism of algorithm is embedded in scatter search algorithm, and combination generates new solution through the structure-solution method of exchanging both sides in reference set, the selection strategy of edge partly comes from RefSet1 and RefSet2, another part is from RefSet1, so as to ensure the diversity and high quality of solution, Simulation experiment proves the feasibility and effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Motion and Constraint Analysis Based on Screw Theory
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The paper introduces a complete constraint analysis method based on screw theory. In the first place, Each KC of product is analysed and decomposed into feature-class KC. Assemblies are then decomposed to parts and joint features. The motion and constraint status is described by screw matrix (twist matrix and wrench matrix). Part-feature diagram(PFD)and constraint-transfer diagram (CTD) are introduced to identify the path for constraint analysis of each feature. After identifying the path, how to make constraint analysis for serial and parallel constraint using MATLAB algorithm is described. Finally, a "DOF&constraint analysis" system is developed via C++ programing and embedded in Pro/ENGINEER environment. Using this analysis system in Pro/ENGINEER significantly reduces design cycle and achieves both efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: A Warranty Service Contract among Manufacturer and Agent
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper focuses on the research of warranty service contract among one manufacturer and one agent. In order to obtain a better result, we use the method of game theory to simulate the interaction between two participants. By maximizing the profit of the manufacturer and the agent, obtaining the manufacturer's optimal sale price, warranty period and warranty price, and the agent's optimal maintenance price or repair price. Finally, the paper presents several numerical examples and parameter analysis to illustrate the models, and put forward some managerial insights.

articleTitle: Research on Temperature Control System in a Hermetic Chamber with Discrete Heaters Based on Fuzzy Control by OPC Technology
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, a novel control strategy based on fuzzy control is introduced to decrease the difference temperature between the two layers in a hermetic chamber with three layer discrete heat sources on both sidewalls (a multi-input-multi-output system). The overall measurement and temperature control system is implemented in PLC and fuzzy control is realized in MATLAB, so we make PLC communicates with MATLAB based on OPC technology. The experiment results show that a better dynamic response and steady-state characteristic of the temperature control system and a well uniformity of the temperature in the chamber can be well achieved by this control strategy and the fuzzy controller.

articleTitle: The Research of Virus Propagation and Immunization Strategy Based on the Restricted Edge Weighted BBV Network Model
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Compared with the BBV network model, the restricted edge weighted BBV network model can express a variety of real-world networks realistically. The research of virus propagation and immunization strategy based on the restricted edge weighted BBV network model will help to solve some problems better in the real networks. We got the virus propagation of the restricted edge weighted BBV network model through simulation experiments. And we found the restricted edge weighted BBV network model, the propagations of SIS virus propagation model and SIR virus propagation model is consistent with the BBV network model. At the same time, the study of immunization strategy on the restricted edge weighted BBV network model show that the immunization strategy of based node betweenness is the best. This conclusion is the same with the BBV network model. But the time to reach steady state after immunization on the restricted edge weighted BBV network model is less than the BBV network model. From the above results can obtain the virus propagation and proper immunization strategy of the restricted edge weighted BBV network model. The results also verify the advantages of the restricted edge weighted BBV network model.

articleTitle: Convergence Analysis for Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A general method for combinatorial optimization problems heuristically by the Ant System approach is proposed. According to the two different conditions, some convergence analysis for Ant Colony System (ACS) are obtained. The global searching and convergence ability are improved by adaptively changing the lower pheromone bound. It is proved that ACS finds an optimal solution with probability 1.

articleTitle: A Method of Echo Signal Generation for UWB Fuze Based on Microstrip Bandpass Filter
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Generation of UWB radio fuze target echo signal is an integral part of the imitation of fuze working process in the UWB fuze test system. And it is the research emphasis in measuring and testing techniques of ultra-wideband fuze. According to ultra-wideband fuze system model, a method of echo signal generation for UWB fuze is proposed based on microstrip bandpass filter and a narrow pulse generator. Parameters for each microstrip filter unit, included spacing, length and width, are calculated. UWB radio fuze target echo signal is generated by the designed microstrip bandpass filter, which demonstrates the validity of this approach.

articleTitle: A Novel Automatic Classification Method for Flash Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet, the network has penetrated into many areas of people's lives. It has become an indispensable communication tool, information access tool and entertainment tool for people. Flash as a new multimedia has become an important part on the Internet. Because the advantages of strong artistic expression, simplified manufacture, flexible interaction, small storage and easy communication, it has been widely used on the Internet. Faced with the growing number of Flash, how to retrieve Flash accurately and efficiently is becoming a noticeable problem. Based on the study of file structures, forming principles and content features, a novel automatic classification method for Flash is proposed in this paper. The algorithm of BP neural network algorithm is adopted in this method. It is called BPFAC which can realize the automatic classification of Flash, and can make retrieval system for Flash more efficient and accurate. On the basis of the optimizing the efficiency of algorithm, we have developed the prototype of BPFAC by C++. Based on two experimental parameters, the Accuracy Rate and the Time Consumption, several comparative experiments have been carried out respectively. Results show that BPFAC has higher accuracy in classification of Flash, and has relatively stable time consumption at the same time.

articleTitle: Two-Sided with Multi-parallel Stations Assembly Line Balancing Problem and Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The assembly line is two-sided with multi-parallel stations assembly line for large products such as heavy vehicles or loaders due to its large space and assembly space, which is very complicated. In order to minimize the assembly stations, a mixed integer linear programming model is set up and CPLEX algorithm based on branch and bound algorithm is presented. Taking a two sided with multi-parallel stations assembly line for loaders as example, the balancing scheme is achieved using the algorithm, and workshop space is saved, and the total time of whole line and transmission time loss are reduced, which is of important instruction significance to the actual manufacturing layout for the two-side with multi-parallel station assembly line.

articleTitle: Reliability-Based Robustness Modeling Approach for Manufacturing System Design Based on Fuzzy Design Axioms
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A poorly designed manufacturing system can foul the quality of even well-designed products, and a robust manufacturing system is the prerequisite to produce the reliable product. Aiming at developing reliability-based robustness analysis in manufacturing system design, this paper proposes a new approach to model the robustness of manufacturing system in design. Firstly, a metric model for the index of manufacturing system robustness is built based on the information axiom and independence axiom of Axiomatic Design. Next, the quantitative computation approach of manufacturing system robustness by means of fuzzy theory is achieved. Finally, the validity of the proposed method is verified by a case study a reliability-based robustness analyzing example of a furniture manufacturing system.

articleTitle: People's Intention towards Public Bicycle System in Wuhan
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Public bicycle system is considered as an essential part of the public transport system in large and medium cities owing to its zero emissions and accessibility. This study was undertaken to establish a conceptual framework for describing the behavioral intention of using public bicycle. A structural equation model was then employed to formulate the relationship between individual's behavioral intention of using public bicycle and its influencing factors. A set of questionnaires was designed and 202 citizens in Wuhan were interviewed in order to collect the required data for empirical study purpose. The study results indicate that the behavioral intention of using public bicycle is influenced not only by the satisfaction towards biking environments and the perceived degree of security and risks, the attitude towards public bicycle and social personality also plays an important role. For inspiring an individual's willingness to using public bicycle, improving the quality of biking environments is a short cut for encouraging people to using public bicycle. The long-term approach for promoting green transportation is to nourish the right attitude toward public bicycle, and thus promote the development of public transportation system.

articleTitle: The Study of New Indiscernible Relation Based on Flexible Logic in Complete Information System
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Rough set theory is used to deal with the imprecise data which attribute's value is discrete. Flexible logic can satisfy the uncertain, incomplete and continuous data processing effectively in artificial intelligence. To re-define the indiscernible relation in rough set using universal equivalence relation, which can deal with both the discrete and continuous attributes directly, the new indiscernible relation can classify all the attributes with unified approach into equivalence classes based on universal (flexible) logic. This can abbreviate the discretization step in traditional processing and simplify the classification. This paper proves that the new definition is reasonable and illustrates it by instance.

articleTitle: Registration of 3D Reconstruction Point Clouds Based on the Assistant Cameras Array System
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Three-dimensional reconstruction plays an important role in the real practice. Since the three-dimensional reconstruction technique based on structured light is seriously restricted by the light conditions, the three-dimensional reconstruction technique based on passive optical binocular vision is widely applied with the superiority of unlimited by the environment conditions. However, the precision of the reconstruction is not satisfying. The point cloud registration technique of three-dimensional reconstruction can greatly improve the drawback, but the traditional ICP algorithm endures a low iteration speed owing to large iterations and the precision is still unsatisfying. This paper presents a point cloud registration technique algorithm of three-dimensional reconstruction based on assistant camera array system, which creatively takes advantage of run length encoding to do the corner recognition, and can acquire accurate registration results without iteration. Experimental results indicate a greater improvement in accuracy and speed compared with ICP algorithm.

articleTitle: Multidimensional Analysis of Seawater Quality Data Based on Graph OLAP
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Studies on seawater quality played an important role on evaluation of marine eutrophication and prediction of marine algal blooms. General studies usually evaluated water quality based on statistical methods and artificial intelligence ways, which were short at dealing with complex marine data. In this study, we presented a way to evaluate seawater quality through calculating differences of water quality between different areas and constructing monitored areas network, developed a multidimensional analysis method for dealing with seawater quality data based on graph OLAP (Online Analyzing and Processing). Our study showed that graph OLAP was an effective way to deal with complex marine data, and WDT (water quality distance threshold) was a helpful characteristic for evaluating marine eutrophication and predicting marine algal blooms.

articleTitle: Matrix Factorization Based Models Considering Item Categories and User Neighbors
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Matrix factorization is a popular collaborative filtering method for recommendation techniques with predictive accuracy and good scalability. In this paper, we propose two models on the basis of basic matrix factorization, namely CW-MF, NICW-MF. CW-MF considers user's preference on item categories and NICW-MF takes into account the impact of user's neighbors to minimize the preference between user and his neighbors. We conduct empirical experiments on MovieLens dataset, and results show that our two models perform well.

articleTitle: The Optimized Implementation of Affine Transformation of S-Box in Rijndael Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Rijndael algorithm as AES has been implemented by hardware recently to improve the performance such as RFID-tag. Based on the research of S-box structure principle, this paper firstly analyzes the problem of short iterative output period and then presents novel hardware architecture of affine transformation based on improved polynomials. The architecture is simulated in Verilog HDL and implemented in FPGA designs. Compared with traditional circuits, the presented architecture further simplifies the operation process and reduces the S-box. Compared with traditional circuits, the presented hardware size is only 75 gates and the optimal ratio reaches 90.23% and even 47.92%.

articleTitle: The Improvement in Detecting Social Network Change Based on Statistical Process Control
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Social network analysis (SNA) has become an important tool for analyzing covert network, especially of terrorist networks. Detecting changes over time from an SNA perspective has an important significance. It may signal an underlying change ignored, and may even predict significant event and behaviors. It is promising to use abnormality detection method based on Statistical Process Control (SPC) in SNA. In this way before, people simply compute parameters of social network on average. However, in the real world, especially of the terrorist networks that whose degree distribution is likely to obey power-law distribution that which is uneven. So the parameters calculated by a simple averaging method can't precisely representative of the characteristics of the network. This paper presents an internal weighted averaging method to calculate the parameters, and applies this method to analyze the al-Qaida datasets. Compared with the previous results, it is significant that this method has better effects.

articleTitle: A Decision Model for Measuring Efficiency and Resource Waste for Production
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper discuss the efficiency evaluation and internal resource waste in complex network production. By using network DEA theory, we proposes a network DEA model that embodies the internal network structure for complex production efficiency evaluation. A sufficient condition for a complex production to be input efficient is discussed. Furthermore, by using the network DEA model, we investigate the internal resource waste in complex production from two different situations. One is the intermediate resource waste that called visible internal resource waste, and another is invisible internal resource waste. Examples shows that to improve the technical efficient of the production may increase its internal resource waste in complex network production.

articleTitle: A High Capacity Watermarking Scheme Based on Fourier descriptor and Sudoku
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Digital watermark is a type of technology to hide significant information which is used to protect the copyright of digital products. In this paper, a high capacity watermarking method, in which the Fourier descriptor is applied to pre-process the watermark and a Sudoku puzzle is used as a reference matrix in embedding and extraction process, is proposed. The storage of memory can be saved efficiently by applying Fourier descriptor. Furthermore, the security of watermarks can be guaranteed by using Sudoku puzzle. Unlike previous algorithms applying Sudoku puzzle in spatial domain, the proposed algorithm works in transformed domain by applying LWT2. In addition, the proposed algorithm can detect the temper location accurately. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed watermarking scheme has a pleasurable preference.

articleTitle: Research on Design of Electric-Drive Scheme for Amphibious Electric Vehicle with Fuel Cell Battery
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The characteristic and requirements of the electric drive system of the amphibious vehicle with the fuel cell battery and permanent magnet motor are introduced firstly. Then based on the mechanism of the integrated hydraulic mechanical transmission that is the traditional drive system, the mechanism scheme of the transmission system of the amphibious vehicle is designed. And also one new scheme of the electric transmission system is proposed. Through the analysis, it is denominated that this electric transmission system could meet the requirements of the amphibious vehicle, which are the driving in a variety of terrain, such as the land, water and so on. The results of the design show that the electric transmission system based on the fuel cell battery is functional and effective, which is much simpler and quieter than the traditional transmission system.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Diagnostic System of Contract Claim Based on Web and Multi-agent
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Contract disputes take up a significant proportion in our country's legal practice, and research on legal diagnosis targeted at contract claim is of great importance. Aiming at features of different users of litigants, agents, lawyers, judges and so on, this paper proposes the establishment Diagnostic System of Contract Claim based on Web and multi-agent technology. It can not only meet the operation environment of distribution isomerism of users, expressing the independent feature of each user, but also provide users with decision support, and the system has extremely strong robustness and reliability.

articleTitle: Object Extraction in Chinese Painting Base on Visual Saliency
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Chinese painting as one of Chinese traditional art forms has important research value. Due to the traditional Chinese painting has the form of abstract, the expression is implicit, with the color fixed limited and so on the artistic characteristic. This paper proposes a novel object extract method based on visual saliency in Chinese painting, which analyzing the characteristics of the Chinese painting. The Proposed algorithm is simple, efficient, and yields full resolution saliency maps. In image experiment we demonstrate that using our saliency extracts object completely in the important regions.

articleTitle: Visualization of IoV Warning Data Based on Warning Velocity Association Model
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Due to the frequent occurrence of the traffic accidents, the passive safety devices fail to meet people's needs. Growing attention has been paid to active safety strategies such as the collision warnings. This paper aims at discovering the related characteristics between the active safety strategy and velocity through the visual analysis of Internet of Vehicles (IoV) warning data. First, seven datasets are collected, in which five datasets are used to formulate hypotheses, and the other two datasets are used for visualization. Second, the relationship hypotheses found between warnings and velocity is that one or more warnings tend to occur when the velocity is at a certain level, and one or more levels of velocity tend to make occurrence of certain warning. Then, the warning velocity association model (WVAM) is designed to visually validate the relation between warnings and velocity. With the help of visual analysis tool Gephi, we get renderings of relationship embodied in WVAM.

articleTitle: The Construction and Planning of Software and Hardware Resource Pool Index System in Large Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Resource Pool is a brand new application form of IT infrastructure in large enterprise, which is as one of the important way to promote infrastructure transformation under the cloud computing environment. According to exactly statistics and analysis in a large power enterprise, a new standard of Resource Pool optimal is proposed in this paper. This standard can objective provide optimal resource allocation decision to information manager, as to improve the effective utilization of resources.

articleTitle: Repetitive Pattern Recognition Based on Representative Descriptors
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper we study the recognition of repetitive patterns. While SIFT (Scale-Invariant Feature Transform) is shown to be very distinctive in feature representation and matching, it is hindered from producing better performance in building recognition as repetitive structures in building images make distance ratio criterion not suitable in matching. Instead of using threshold as an alternative to distance ratio, we use a similarity based method to cluster SIFT descriptors and then match only the representative descriptors in all the clusters. This is shown to improve recognition rate and also save computation expenses in experiments with several building database. In order to further speed up the recognition, we propose to apply SIFT matching only to the top N candidates selected by vocabulary tree based matching. This helps to reduce computation load and retain recognition performance maximally. Experiments with building and non-building images verify the validity of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on File Organization Mechanism Based on Multidimensional Index
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The continuing increasing of data amount make the traditional file management systems get into trouble in retrieval massive data information. Current mainstream file systems are focused on data access performance, reliability, but little attention costed to the correlation between data feature and data. According to the current file management system's existing disadvantages in file organization and retrieval, a fast query file management mode of coal quality informatization is Put forward under the coal enterprise's demand for file management. Analyzed the kinds of coal quality file in details, put forward a file organization way by integrating node with information and multi-dimensional document classification, adopt a topic relevance analysis algorithm and semantic similarity calculation to realize fast text retrieval. Finlly, through the design of protyping system and performance testing, the results show that the feasibility and efficiency of the theory is realized.

articleTitle: The Interacting Interest Relationship of the Donor, the Evaluator and the Quality Supervisor of a Rural Development Project
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Beginning with the game relationship of the donor, the quality supervisor and the evaluator in the process of evaluating a rural development project, this paper analyzes the factors that have effects on the quality evaluation of the project, and proceeds to conclude that there exists information asymmetry in the agency relationship the project donor has with the project quality supervisor and the project evaluator, and that both the quality supervisor and the evaluator are likely to pose a moral hazard. It also discovers that a collusive relationship exists between the quality supervisor and the evaluator in the process of project evaluation, that the evaluation strategy chosen by the evaluator has a direct effect on the quality evaluation of the project, and that an incentive and penal mechanism put in place can help achieve the consistency of the parties' interests and objectives.

articleTitle: Improving Inter-Task Communication Performance on Multi-Core Packet Processing Platform
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Software data plane has been regarded as the main hardware platform for next generation network infrastructure due to its well programmability and flexibility. However, current software lacks support of high performance intertask communication mechanism, which has been one of main limitations on software packet processing. Thus, this paper puts forward a lockless communication mechanism, which is realized through lockless circular queues. And Through building independent communication channel between any pair of network function, all network functions connected with our mechanism could avoid most overhead caused by synchronization and mutual exclusion. And through packet batching, our solution could achieve high throughput. At last, we build a prototype to verify the execution efficiency of our system.

articleTitle: The Synchronization Reconfiguration for Compatibility GNSS Signals
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A variety of satellite navigation system with cooperative navigation is an important development trend of the future GNSS. Based on the needs of multimode signals, analyze the characteristics of new signals. Furthermore, the reconfiguration strategies of multimode signals are studied. Taking synchronous processing speed, accuracy, resource utilization, complexity or something like these into account, the reconfiguration driving, reconfiguration panning, reconfiguration implementation are designed, and then the reconfiguration overall controlling strategy is formed. The strategy is reasonable, efficient, and reconfigurable for the multimode signals. The feasibility and necessity of multimode satellite navigation signal is supplied by the analysis of multimode signal frequency and multimodality modulation.

articleTitle: Model and Algorithm of Blank Design of Seamless Steel Tube for Interval Billet Size
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Due to the discreteness of value in the domain and the minimum batch limit, blank design of seamless steel tube is a new problem, which is also an NP hard problem. To describe the problem, an integer programming model is established. Then, according to the features of the problem, a two-stage algorithm named MRS-MTAGH, which is based on greedy strategy and matrix transformations, is proposed to solve the problem. Finally, a simple example is tested to prove the algorithm is effective and efficient.

articleTitle: Research on Resource Optimization Method under Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Specific to the existed method, which easily occurs the preference to some sort resources when weighing node resources resulting in lower resource utilization phenomenon, this paper put forward one sort of node ranking based mapping methods TK-Match and corresponding several modified methods. TK-Match firstly ranked the network nodes according to multiple resources through the way of Top-k dominated model, and on the basis of which, conducted mapping to virtual network based on NMT. This mapping process included two aspects, node mapping and link circuit mapping, and took node selection factor NF as the selection standard of physical node when mapping nodes, however, NF comprehensively considered two factors including RS value of physical nodes and the hop counts mapping from link circuit between NMT and PCNP to physical route of DCN. And it also compared TK-Match method and other modified methods in details through test during the process of solving the properties on resource distribution issue.

articleTitle: Research on the functional relation between Kansei evaluation and smart watch
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In product model design, it is of great significance to get to know consumer's perceptual feelings, i.e. Kansei, about the product so as to improve design and work out the desired product. In this paper, smart watch samples are firstly selected by referring to various kinds of sources. By decomposing watch model structure using morphological analysis method, the key features that appeal to consumers are identified. Kansei is described by and exist in the form of Kansei word, by performing a Factor Analysis on the reduced Kansei Words, the most representative Kansei Words are selected. Then, subjects are invited to make a Kansei evaluation for the watch samples. At last, based on the Quantification Theory Type ?, the prediction model for smart watch design is established in the form of multivariate linear regression model. With the functional relation between Kanseis and watch features being worked out, the design of smart watch can be well directed.

articleTitle: A Variable-Fidelity Approximate Modelling Method Based on Nested Design of Experiments
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In the variable fidelity (VF) metamodeling method, an approximation model of high precision needs to be obtained with a few high fidelity (HF) sampling points available, so it's important to conduct research on the experiment design. This paper carries out research into an improved nested design of experiment. Firstly, the improved successive local enumeration (ISLE) algorithm is proposed to build the low fidelity (LF) experiment design. Then the process of selecting the HF sample points from LF sample points is converted into the Maximum diversity problem (MDP) with constraint. Finally the HF sampling points are obtained by solving the MDP. To verify the validity of the sampling method presented for VF metamodeling, the optimal Latin hypercube is applied to produce equal sampling points for comparison.

articleTitle: Design and Effectiveness Analysis of a Personalized Information Resource Service System
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: According to the user's interest model and the characteristics of information resources, personalized recommendation strategy is used to select the appropriate information resources from the database for users. The system provides feedback to the guiding teacher on the student's learning experiences and learning diary. Also, a customer satisfaction evaluation model of the system has been constructed and the investigation has been made. The results of the investigation demonstrate that most users are satisfied with the use of a personalized information resource services system for assisting their graduation design.

articleTitle: Visual Weighted SPECK Image Coding Based on WBCT
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
