With constraint of kinematic characters of machine tool, NURBS curve is divided into curve segmentations and feed-rates are planned in these segmentations, then feed-rate transitions of discrete points of adjacent segmentations are processed and interpolation points are determined according to feed-rates of discrete points, interpolation cycle and chord error. Based on these, NURBS curve interpolation based on piecewise feed-rate planning is implemented. Experimental result indicates that the proposed algorithm is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Application of an Improved Ant Colony in Faults Tracking
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Concerning the problems that traditional manual interpretation of seismic fault is highly subjective and low accuracy, high complexity of ant tacking fault, an improved automatic tracking ant colony algorithm in fault was proposed, which can improve the speed of fault identification by reducing the numbers of ants. They used C3 coherence technique to process seismic data, then use the Gaussian filtering to process the bisect, followed is to divide the bisect into numbers of m*m small data blocks, therefore determining whether placing electric ant or not according to coherent distribution value of each pixel in data block, finally use the Calculation method based on the gradient direction of determine the ant tracking direction. Experimental results show that the improved ant colony not only can identify the fault lines correctly, but also improves the tracking of the fault lines' speed.

articleTitle: Design of Clothing Supply Chain Network Based on Stochastic Simulation
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The design of clothing supply chain network is one of the most key issues in clothing supply chain management. This article proposes a multi-echelon clothing supply chain network design model with uncertain price. The model includes suppliers of fabric, suppliers of accessory, clothing factories, distributors, and customer zones and makes managers of clothing supply chain network to maximize the total profits. A method which integrates simulation with chance-constrained programming is used to deal with the model. This method is employed to determine the configuration of clothing supply chain network. And the best value of any confidence level can be obtained using this method and CPLEX 12.6. The results of computational experiments show the proposed model is effective and pragmatic in designing clothing supply chain network under uncertainty.

articleTitle: Research on Noise Suppression Performance of High-Speed Broadband FH Communication System Based on MSK
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: FH(frequency hopping) is widely concerned in the field of communication because of its outstanding ability of noise suppression. The suppression ability of FH communication can be improved by increasing the bandwidth and hopping rate. MSK is chosen as a modulation of high-speed broadband FH communication system to research the suppression ability of FH to different noise signals. The diagram between ratio peak and ISR (interference-signal power) can be given in different bandwidths and different hopping rates. It is verified that the broadband high-speed FH communication system with MSK as the modulation mode has not only a smaller BER (bit error rate) but also a higher noise suppression.

articleTitle: Research on Weight Calculation Method for Requirement Indexes of Marine Shaft System Based on KANO Model
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Pointed to the problems that it was lack of scientific and standardizated method for acquiring design requirements of marine shaft system, and mapping them to each design stage of marine shaft system, decomposition model based on quality function deployment for marine shaft system design was studied. Furthermore considering the influence of the linear relationship processing method for weight calculation of requirement indexes for marine shaft system to the scientificalness and rationality in the traditional house of quality building process, weight calculation method for requirement index of marine shaft system on KANO model was studied, which could provide effective solution for getting reasonable weight for requirement indexes of marine shaft system. Finally, the weight calculation for requirement indexes of a shaft system was taken as an example to illustrate the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Forward Greedy Heuristic Algorithm for N-Vehicle Exploration Problem(NVEP)
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper introduces the N-Vehicle Exploration Problem (NVEP), and some properties of it. Then based on the previous work of Backward Greedy Heuristic Algorithm (BGH) [11], a improved algorithm, called Forward Greedy Heuristic Algorithm (FGH) has been put forward. It is proposed from the opposite direction of BGH, and has the same complexity as BGH, of which is O(n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>). Last, the compared results calculated by ten cases from [6] show that FGH has a better effectiveness.

articleTitle: Design of PCB Detection and Diagnosis System for a Type of Ballistic Missile Based on Embedded Technology
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Given the fact of failure of PCB detection and diagnosis equipment for a type of ballistic missile in locating faulty component, PCB detection and diagnosis system for a type of ballistic missile is developed by integrating such technologies as microprocessor-based testing technology, fault diagnosis technology and embedded technology to realize accurate fault localization of modular circuit and key components. General design plan of the detection and diagnosis system is expounded herein, including designing circuit of system hardware, configuration of software structure with slave microprocessor of the system, as well as design of logic testing main program. Experimental results indicate that this system is effective in fast and accurately locating broken PCB components, which makes it a valuable reference for studying on testing and fault diagnosis methodology of complex weapon equipments.

articleTitle: Feature Weighting Method Based on Real-Coded Genetic Algorithm in Text Categorization
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Feature weighting technique can improve the accuracy of text categorization, TF-IDF is a generally used feature weighting method. Currently, some improved methods based TF-IDF have been proposed, but there is not a method that is able to comprehensive each algorithm's advantages. So, feature weighting method based on real-coded genetic algorithm (GA) is proposed in this paper, the real-coded GA is used to calculate the feature weights. Concrete steps as follows: firstly, use information gain to reduce dimension. Secondly, use real-coded GA to calculate each feature weights. Lastly, classify text according to the weighted cosine distance. Experiments proved that the real-coded GA method is superior to the traditional TF-IDF method.

articleTitle: Medical Record Text Analysis Based on Latent Semantic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the rapid development of e-medical industry, large amount of data is accumulated in various data bases in the form of text. A considerable part of these data is manually recorded and thus is unstructured, which need semantic analysis. This paper proposed an improved Latent Dirichlet Allocation model based on BM25 mixture weights method aiming to analyze Chinese patient medical record on latent semantics. Test shows a conspicuous reduction on perplexity, thus proving its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on the Signal Processing Method for Balancing Measurement System Based on EEMD
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The precise detection of unbalancing problems of the rotor balancing not only can eliminate the security risks but also bring huge economic benefits. Aiming at the signal processing method for automobile flywheel-based balancing measurement system. This paper applied mathematical morphology filter to extracting the vibration signal as preprocessing to eliminate the pulse interference and then use the method of ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD) to get the intrinsic mode function (IMF), then extract the frequency, amplitude and phase of the signal by Hilbert transform. The simulation verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method in signal processing.

articleTitle: Video Jitter Detection Algorithm Based on Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A simple and efficient detection algorithm is proposed for the problem of image jitter detection in video quality diagnosis system. In the algorithm the gray projection feature is selected to calculate the correlation of motion vector, which effectively solve the threshold selection problem. PCA is used to calculate the main direction of displacement vector. And the projection relationship of motion vectors in the main direction of displacement vector is used to judge the jitter. This way effectively utilizes the statistical characteristics, enhances the ability of anti-noise and reduces the rate of false positives. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively detect the jitter of video images, and can meet the needs of the actual work.

articleTitle: Multi-level Evaluation Model for Intangible Cultural Heritage Status Based on Fuzzy Set Theory
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Chinese culture is a composite of these diverse Intangible Cultural Heritage (ICH). Large number of Chinese ICH needs to be protected. The ICH have its own personalized feature, resulted in the different survival state. When draw a ICH protection strategy, we must take into account not only the differences but also the feasibility of protection strategy. Therefore, this study uses Fuzzy set theory to rate these different ICH. Facing to different hierarchy ICH, differentiated protection strategy should be adopted. Owing to vague concepts frequently represented in ICH data, the information of the status of ICH is described based on Fuzzy set theory. Then the evaluated alternatives are arranged in a hierarchical structure with several levels, and the weighting function of each level criterion is quantified based on AHP method. Fuzzy Synthetic Evaluations is used to determine the rank of all ICH alternatives. Finally, the development of some ICH were taken as examples in this study.

articleTitle: A HMM-Based Spectrum Access Method Used for HF Communication
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Aiming at the drawbacks of spectrum access strategy based on listening before transport in HF ALE protocols, a modified HMM is proposed to predict the channel availability and decide channel access. Giving full consideration to the usage regulation of HF channel, this model makes better use of the 'partially available' channel which is considered as 'occupied' under traditional two-state channel partition mechanism by a three-state one. The simulation results tells that in comparison to existing two-state HMM, this method uses channel longer with a lower switch rate and has higher predicting accuracy and channel utilization compared with traditional listening before transport strategy especially when 'partially available' channel appears frequently or SNR is low.

articleTitle: A Small Form Factor and Low Cost 8x10Gb/s Optical Transmission System Based on Digital-Wrapper Technology
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A low cost and small form factor 8×10G optical transmission system based on digital-wrapper technology is proposed and developed. This device can be used for typical Point to Point transmission or metro WDM ring application, it can also be flexibly configured for a Point to Multi Points (P2MP) application for access network. When it is used for P2MP application, 2 bytes GCC0 of Optical Transport Network (OTN) overhead are used to transparently transport network management message by the High speed Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) and digital wrapper chip, so that the in-band network management information is embedded with the real traffic for the long distance transmission. The most important thing is that at the HUB node up to 8 link OTN overhead can be in parallel processed by the FPGA, which can simultaneously support multiple in-band network management from Hub location to up to 8 different remote nodes. In addition, the forward error correction (FEC) is developed, and it is effectively evaluated in terms of network performances such as the receiver sensitivity, the dispersion penalty, and optical signal to noise ratio (OSNR) tolerance/improvement by the FEC. The long term error free transmission test has also been conducted for the 160 km single mode fiber and over 24 hours.

articleTitle: Hybrid Learning Algorithm Based Modified Particle Swarm Clustering for RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A hybrid learning algorithm based modified particle swarm clustering for RBF neural network was proposed. Firstly to confirm the positions of hidden layer RBF centers using modified particle swarm clustering algorithm, then to train the RBF neural network and get the output layer weights by least square method. The new algorithm was used for pattern classification, function approximation and system identification and the results show that this algorithm is simpler and has high precision and efficiency.

articleTitle: A Novel Quad-Band ACS-FED Antenna
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A compact quad-band asymmetric coplanar strip (ACS) fed printed monopole antenna, is presented in this paper. It consists of composite right/left-handed transmission line (CRLH-TL) unit cells and open-ended stub, which improves the impedance bandwidth of the zero-order mode (5.5 GHz), first-negative-order mode (4.4 GHz) and second-negative-order mode (3.5 GHz), as well as generate a new resonant mode at 2.4 GHz. The antenna occupies a very compact size of 21.6×12 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Simulated and measured results show the antenna's good properties of return losses less than -10 dB, omnidirectional radiation patterns and high peak gains in the quad frequency bands. The proposed antenna is a good candidate for modern wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Research and Design of UAV Control System Based on SOA
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) control systems in cross-platform and wide malleable, and break the traditional one-on-one control model between UAV control system and UAV, this paper proposes a SOA-based design and implementation of UAV control system. Using a middleware layer, ESB, Enterprise Service Bus, to help achieve intelligent management between different services in SOA architecture, providing WebSphere MQ messaging middleware between the control system and the UAV to achieve many-to-one and even more many-to-many communication.

articleTitle: Summer Sportswear Fabrics Research of Jade Fiber and Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Due to the economic development and the change of people's living habits, sports have become more and more important in people's life. Which promotes the development of sports apparel industry. Economic conditions improved, consumers are more serious to the function of wearing apparel, especially to sportswear. For summer sportswear, consumers consider how to cool, how to prevent the bacterium, making a comfortable and healthy dressing environment. Research which has the function of cool feeling and antibacterial sportswear fabrics meet the consumption demand that is constantly updated and the fierce market competition. This study chooses two kinds of fiber. The one is jade fiber which have cool feeling and antibacterial effect, the other is tencelsun fiber which has high strength and can be biodegradable. Two kinds of raw materials can be interwoven into nine different kinds of apparel fabrics, according to the orthogonal experiment. Analyzing the connection between three influence factors (the raw materials, mixed proportion and the organizational structure) and the fabric performance (cool feeling, antimicrobial properties, moisture absorption, air permeability, quick dry and elastic recovery rate) by orthogonal experiment. Then use the grey nearly optimal comprehensive evaluation method to get the fabric with the best comprehensive properties.

articleTitle: BANS-Based Cloud Resources Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: As one recently developed technology, cloud computing is differ in various aspects with distributed computing and grid computing. Traditional monitoring system designed for the gird computing or distributed system is not suitable for the platform of cloud computing. And we have proposed a bionic autonomic nervous system (BANS)-based cloud resource monitoring model to deals with the common issues of scalability and flexibility with monitoring system as well as support autonomy. The autonomy provides an efficient design that enables our monitoring system to both disperse pressure of primary monitoring node on data processing and reduce the network traffic load. Experimental evidence is presented that the BANS-based cloud resource monitoring system has a good performance. And it has been successfully deployed in Collaborative Autonomic Computing Laboratory cloud platform.

articleTitle: High-Speed Classification of Financial Network Public Opinion Based on Hadoop
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Financial network public opinion refers to those influential tendentious views and comments, spread through the network, on economic issues in real life. It reflects the economic focus in the corresponding period. To learn about the dynamics of financial market, processing and analysis of those opinions is needed. However, in the face of vast amounts of data, of which the analysis requires a great mount of storage and computations, standalone exposes the shortcoming of low storage capacity and slow processing speed problems. In this paper, the Hadoop distributed platform is applied to deal with this situation. Moreover, this article has presented the application of MapReduce programming model in key processes of public opinion text processing, including preprocessing, feature selection and vectorization of text. Experiments have showed that the Hadoop cluster well solved the disadvantages of low storage capacity and low-performance in computation.

articleTitle: Event Relations Extraction Based on Event Co-occurrence Network
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Cognitive scientists believe that humans memorize and understand the real world through "event". Event relations extraction has become increasingly important in some natural language processing applications. In this paper, we firstly consider the event as a basic semantic unit and present a new event co-occurrence network. Then, we study event relations extraction based on this event co-occurrence network. We used the association rule mining method to extract event co-occurrence pairs from event co-occurrence networks, and got the semantic relations between event classes after generalizing and analyzing these event co-occurrence pairs. The experimental results show that our event relations extraction method has good performance.

articleTitle: An Improved Compressive Tracking Algorithm Based on LBP
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper presents an improved compressive tracking algorithm based on LBP (Local Binary Pattern). Compressive Tracking is a simple and effective tracking algorithm, however there are a number of problems that need to be addressed. In our algorithm, the target is represented with Haar-like features generated from three channels of RGB LBP image with completely random location and channel rather than from a single channel. We also propose a new search strategy to update the search window instead of a fixed tracking window. The improved algorithm is tested on various video sequences and the results show that the algorithm achieves stable tracking on moved target and has a good performance compared with the state-of-the-art algorithm in terms of efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: Compact Dual-Band CPW-Fed Filtering Antenna for WLAN Applications
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A compact dual-band printed flltering antenna fed by CPW(co planar wave guide) is presented. Though printing on the same substrate board like as a conventional antenna, the proposed structure not only own the unit of radiator of the antenna, but also a second-order band-pass fllter, with two fllter poles provided by two rectangular -- circle with a stub. According to the fllter speciflcations, the antenna design process for the proposed flltering antenna is depicted in enough detail. And the operating bandwidth of the proposed antenna is broadened and high selectivity is also improved correspondingly. The measured results of the proposed antenna, including the S-parameters, total radiated power, current distributions and antenna gains versus frequency, have a very good agreement with the original design and simulation. The proposed novel antenna, with a very small area of 32.7×28.4 mm2, is single board structure and generates two usable resonant frequencies at about, 5.2(5.15-5.35), 5.8 (5.725-5.825) GHz for WLAN applications.

articleTitle: Compressed Sensing MRI Reconstruction Algorithm Based on Contourlet Transform and Split Bregman Method
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Compressed sensing (CS) based methods have recently been used to reconstruct magnetic resonance (MR) images from undersampled measurements, which is known as CS-MRI. In traditional CS-MRI, wavelet transform can hardly capture the information of image curves and edges. In this paper, we present a new CS-MRI reconstruction algorithm based on contourlet transform and split Bregman method. Contrast with wavelet based algorithms, the proposed method not only enforces the curve sparsity of MR images with fast computation, but also outperforms on reconstruction accuracy. Numerical results show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: 3D Model Classification and Recognition Method Based on Tensor Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper propose a 3D model classification and recognition method based on tensor principal component analysis. Firstly, the 3D model is transformed into 2D view and expressed in tensor, and then feature vector from multiple angles of tensor is extracted. On the basis of multi-linear principal component analysis and linear discriminate analysis, we present a method for merged weighted multi-linear principal component analysis with weighted linear discriminate analysis (WMPCA + WLDA). This method is not only can save spatial correlation of the projected view, but also can improve feature recognition of the 3D model through using class label information and features weight. Experiments on Princeton Shape Benchmark has shown that the method is superior to the conventional MPCA, MPCA + LDA, WMPCA + LDA and other methods on classification results of 3D model.

articleTitle: Research of High Efficiency X-Band Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: RF power amplifier is at the end of the radio transmitter, it provides RF power for receiving antenna. RF amplifier is more energy emission link module, and also is the strongest non-linear module, to improve its efficiency to extend battery life and improve its linearity can be improved data efficiency. Linearity and efficiency of class AB RF power amplifier is good compromise and widely used. X-band GaAs FET power amplifier class AB presents selected work points, and impedance matching method to achieve high efficiency. We discussed the amplifier input loop impedance converting circuit, transistor amplifier circuit and the design ideas of the output circuit impedance conversion circuit. The design is very important in analog signal processing circuit class AB high power amplifier. The simulation and experimental results show that the amplifier is in the range of 9.3GHz ~ 9.4GHz, P1db for 24.5dbm, its gain of 10 dB, and mesh distortion rate is very low.

articleTitle: Multi-agent System Design for Energy Saving in Intelligent Building
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, intelligent agent techniques have provided a new way for intelligent buildings to a higher level. Although the multi-agent-system application in intelligent buildings, especially for energy-saving application is just in its initial stage, it has drawn more and more attention. With the advance of agent technology, wireless sensor network and open standards in building automation systems, it is now feasible to build an intelligent multi-agent system for energy conservation. In this paper, we present a building control system architecture based on multi-agent and the way to realize energy efficiency without compromising occupants' comfort.

articleTitle: Detecting Falsified Timestamps in Evidence Graph via Attack Graph
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Network forensics investigations aims to find a chain of evidences that helps reconstructing the alleged attack scenario. This often requires the check of timestamps of the logs to reconstruct the event. Yet, it is relatively easy for criminals to tamper with the event logs, which results in the evidence graph with falsified timestamps and hence hinders the event reconstruction. The aim of this work paper is to propose an algorithm detects these falsified timestamps and re-creates the true evidence graph. Our algorithm relies on attack graphs of the system environment which models known vulnerability sequences that were exploited to launch the attack. We demonstrate the effectiveness and performance of our algorithm via a possible attack scenario in a network environment running a file server and a database server.

articleTitle: Research on Word Sentimental Classification Based on Transductive Learning
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: At present, word sentimental orientation identification researches mainly fall into two categories: Machine learning and semantic comprehension, machine learning seems to work in specific-field words, but cannot handle general-field words effectively, and semantic comprehension also cannot get ideal scores at precision and recall, therefore, we put forward a fusion of transductive learning and semantic comprehension for determining words' sentimental orientation. In this paper, we firstly modify Hownet knowledge, on the basis of exist primitives, the fifth primitive -- "sentimental primitive" was proposed, and integrate it into Hownet manually, secondly, we propose a new word sentimental similarity calculation method to compute words' sentimental value, at last, combine this way with transductive learning for judgment words' sentimental orientation. The performance of experiments show that, compared with SVM and traditional semantic comprehension, it can get better results.

articleTitle: Monaural Speech Enhancement Using Joint Dictionary Learning with Cross-Coherence Penalties
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In the real world, the interferers are often nonstationary and potentially similar to the speech where the conventional speech enhancement (SE) approaches are often incompetent. In the recently proposed sparsity-based approaches, the clean speech is often recovered from the degraded speech by sparse coding of the mixture over the composite dictionary consisting of the speech and interferer dictionaries. However, parts of the speech component are explained by interferer dictionary atoms and vice-versa, which cause source confusion. The existing approaches learn the speech and interferer dictionaries separately and the source confusion is relatively large. In this paper, we introduce a new joint dictionary learning (JDL) method for SE which learns the speech and interferer dictionaries jointly. In the proposed method, the information of speech, interferer and their mixture and the cross-coherence of dictionaries are taken into account. These two parts constitute the new cost function and an algorithm is presented to solve this JDL optimization problem. The experimental results show that our proposed approach can obtain better performances than other tested approaches, and the advantages are more obvious when the input signal-to-interferer ratios are low.

articleTitle: An Improved Method Focusing on X-Band Low Phase Noise Sweep Source
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper proposes a method to improve the phase noise of a X-band sweep source. It is based on a PLL(Phase-locked loop) circuit driven by a DDS(Direct Digital Synthesizer), and an offset source is introduced in the PLL circuit. The DDS is used to generate low-frequency sweep signal, the PLL circuit is used to multiply the low-frequency sweep signal, and the offset is introduced to decrease the phase noise. This method decreases the phase noise of the sweep source greatly.

articleTitle: Prediction of Chinese Financial Total Loan Amount via Unbiased Grey-Fuzzy-Markov Chain Method
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The national investment trend plays an important role in economics. This paper predicts the Chinese financial total loan amount as an indicator of the investment tendency by using an unbiased grey-Markov chain method, which combines the unbiased grey model GM(1,1) and Markov chain with fuzzy classification. This method takes advantage of the prediction power of the original Grey-Markov framework and also eliminate the grey bias existing in the original GM(1,1) and improve the anti-jamming ability of the model to overcome the random fluctuation in the data. Our prediction shows that the Chinese annual investment will continue increasing in the following five years with 15% growth rate.

articleTitle: Optical Fiber Bragg Grating Ground Settlement Monitoring System Based on 4G
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Fiber Bragg grating sensors are often used to monitor ground settlement. However, there are some problems that cannot be ignored, such as the poor intuitive performance of monitoring results, the weak comprehensive management function, incapable of sharing remote data. In order to solve the problems mentioned above, a fiber Bragg grating remote monitoring system for ground subsidence based on 4G network has been designed. The system structure is a hybrid of two tier C/S and three tier B/S, applying virtual instrument technique to develop front end data acquisition software, adopting asp.net and C# language to develop the website, while using Android to develop mobile phone terminal APP. Those laid a good foundation for monitoring real-time data. At the same time, remote data transmission make use of 4G network, compared to the GSM/GPRS, it effectively improves the data transfer speed and accuracy. The system contained collection and management of monitoring data, real time dynamic display of monitoring result, remote access control and alarm monitoring. So that the functions are gathered in the integral whole to realize intelligent and networked management of ground subsidence monitoring. In the process of monitoring the ventilation shaft wall in a coal mine, the system runs well and provides a powerful guarantee for safety production of coal mine.

articleTitle: Process Control Parameters Optimal Selection Based on Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: PID control algorithm has been extensively used in process controls. But the PID control parameters tuning is a complicated process in the controller. This paper proposes a solution to do optimal selection of process control parameters by particle swarm algorithm. The particle swarm algorithm can be applied to obtain the best control parameters of the fitness function with least-error and least-overshoot optimization criterion. A better control effect is achieved in the process simulation of the second order system's response using these control parameters, which indicates that particle swarm algorithm for process control parameters' optimal selection has a high value in practice.

articleTitle: The Fast Design Method of Band Tunable Cavity Bandpass Filter
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, the design principle of the coaxial cavity filter is described. The design of the position and the size of the coupling hole and the input and output coupling ring are analyzed in detail. A simple and convenient method for the design of tunable cavity bandpass filter based on HFSS and Designer is proposed, and the method is used to design the FM bandpass filter.

articleTitle: Fast Image Colorization Based on Local and Global Consistency
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Image colorization refers to the process of semiautomatic adding colors to a grayscale image. A novel image colorization approach based on local and global consistency is proposed, which applies the graph-based semi-supervised learning theory to solve the problem of colorization. Firstly, constructing a graph model according to the similarities between pixels, and then determine a quadratic cost function with sufficient smoothness which can fully guarantee the image structure information, finally the colors are propagated to the un-colored pixels from colored pixels by minimizing the cost function. In order to meet the time requirements when dealing with high resolution images, the authors further propose a segmentation-based approach, instead of directly on pixels, which regards image segmented region as the basic unit during colors propagating. Experiments on different natural images demonstrate that our approach's computational complexity is significantly reduced while achieves high quality colorization results compared with two existing techniques.

articleTitle: A Disease Detection Method of Liver Based on Improved Back Propagation Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The computer-aided diagnosis of liver disease plays an important role in timely detection and treatment of liver. Conventional identification methods based on back propagation neural network (BPNN) get problems of overlong training time and local optimum. This paper proposes an application of improved BPNN on liver disease identification and the improvements of BPNN are based on self-adaptive learning rate and momentum in training. Noise suppression and feature extraction of liver CT image which obtained from a hospital in Hangzhou are processed first. A comparison between standard BPNN and improved BPNN shows that the latter gets less training time and better accuracy.

articleTitle: High Performance PCIe Interface for the TPCM Based on Linux Platform
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper presents a data transmission mechanism between the Trusted Platform Control Module (TPCM) and motherboard of host PC via Peripheral Component Interconnect Express (PCIe). The main task contains framework, a finite-state machine, a Linux driver and system testing. Embedded in Design Wave Core (DWC), the Directional Memory Access (DMA) produces measured transfer speeds up to 149MBps for reading and 145MBps for writing, which can content the requirements of the TPCM for high-speed data transmission bandwidth.

articleTitle: A Hardened Phase-Locked Loop Using Novel Charge Pump
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A radiation-hardened phase-locked loop (PLL) has been proposed in which a novel numerical control restrain (NCR) circuit is applied in charge pump (CP) to reduce the control voltage perturbation and the recovery time caused by the single energetic particle strikes. A PLL based on this technique was design with 130nm CMOS process and the corresponding shows that the peak of voltage perturbation reduces by up to 80% and the recovery time reduces by up to 50% by employing this technique compared with the traditional one.

articleTitle: The Research of Forecasting Cash Inflow and Outflow Based on Time Series Analysis
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the development of China's Internet economy, online shopping is becoming more common, This article for the financial products of Yu E Bao, From the perspective of big data, based on the traditional method of time series model ARMA, Using the method of ARMA plus single-point prediction to forecast cash inflow and outflow, I hope that my research can provide a relatively reasonable reference to money managers.

articleTitle: The Marking Method of 3D Tooth Model Based on Seed-Growing and Surface Clipping
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: It is a research focus of computer graphics aided orthodontics in terms of realizing the local texture mapping of 3D tooth model to mark the 3D tooth model easily and quickly. According to the problem of incomplete mapping area appearing in local texture mapping of surfaces constructed by triangular mesh, this paper selects and locks the 3D model local area fastly and accurately by means of seed-growing and surface clipping firstly, and then realizes the mapping relation by VTK mapping technology. Meanwhile, the algorithm in this paper proposed can control texture mapping position, the size of mapping area and texture mapping direction effectively based on actual demand. The algorithm ensures the integrity and continuity of the area to a certain extent, and it is also reasonable to distribute 2D coordinates to 3D points in target area. The experimental results show that this method can efficiently, evenly and completely mark the 3D tooth model, and have good real-time performance and vivid effect.

articleTitle: Study on Framework of Interactive and Collaborative Decision Making and Design of Support System Based on Network Center
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: According to practical needs of group collaborative decision making problems in network era and based on application features of group network planning technology, the method of group task planning based on network center is proposed, which achieves the decomposition of decision task and solving process of cooperation by group decision makers. Meanwhile, the interactive and collaborative decision making framework based on Network Center is constructed, and the decision model integrated by sub task solving and task plan is analyzed. At last, the overall design scheme of interactive and collaborative decision making support system based on network center is presented. The decision making framework and support system design embodies the characteristics of the group task planning and interactive collaboration, which has a good application prospect in the development and deployment of the network centric decision support system in the future.

articleTitle: Community Detection in Multi-dimensional Network
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Community structure is one of the hidden characteristics of complex network topology. Detecting the community structure is crucial to understand and utilize the network structure. Existing methods are mostly detecting the community on a one-dimensional network, which is based on only one kind of relationship between the nodes. In this paper, as the prerequisite that there are various ways of people connection in real world, we modeling the multiple relationships of group members in the complex network as a multi-dimensional network. Then we used the traditional community detection to infer the community structure from each dimension of our model. Finally, we define the sibling matrix to map the inferred different community structures from the multi-dimensional network into a comprehensive association, so we can find the hidden community of the complex network. Experimental results show that compared with existing algorithms, the proposed algorithm has higher performance.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Efficiency of Paper-Cutting Cultural Symbol's Attributes Using ANP Approach
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: It is increasingly important to account for cognizance of cultural symbol during the product design process. The relationship among the paper-cutting cultural symbol's attributes was explored in this study. A ANP approach was used to analyze the effects of different cultural elements on product design. And a design practice was carried out to verify the results. This study identifies the importance of individual cultural symbol's attribute for product designers.

articleTitle: Modeling Research on a Solar Tower Thermal Collection-Natural Gas Turbine Power Generation System
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Solar tower-gas turbine power generation system could push forward the commercialization process of solar energy utilization due to its lower cost, lower risk of research and development as well its ability to overcome the random and wave character issues. In order to study the heat transfer and power transformation characters of solar tower-gas turbine power system and the influences of parameters on the system performances, component models of the heat transfer and power transformation were developed for the compression chamber, foam ceramics receiver, combustion chamber and gas turbine. The models were simulated by Matlab software to analyze the influences of pressure ratio, foam ceramics receiver surface area and inlet air temperature on the systems. The research can provide some references for the design and operation of the system.

articleTitle: Parallel Implementation of OpenVX on Firefly2 GPU
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Given the fact that the traditional GPU mainly supports the parallel computing with SIMD (Single Instruction Multiple Data) and SIMT (Single Instruction Multiple Thread) mode, the Firefly2 GPU (Graphic Processing Unit) has special hardware configuration mechanism and can be used for paralleling computing on data-level, thread-level and operated-level. This paper presents parallel implementation of OpenVX kernels on Firefly2 GPU with the method by combing the operation level parallelism with data level parallelism. Experimental results indicate satisfactory speedup of the parallel implementation and show that the Firefly2 is suitable for graphics and image processing.

articleTitle: FLCFE: A Novel Method for Extracting Content Features of Flash
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the advancement and development of the Internet, Flash has penetrated into all aspects of people's lives. As a popular multimedia, Flash has the advantages of strong artistic expressions, simple manufacture, flexible interaction and small storage, so Flash is widely used on the Internet. Currently, the shortages of researches about extracting content features of Flash seriously impose restrictions on the retrieval and utilization of Flash. Therefore, this paper proposes a novel method called FLCFE which is used for extracting content structure features from Flash. The method can effectively extract the content features of Flash, such as metadata information and component elements. On the basis of optimizing the efficiency of FLCFE, we build an experimental prototype of FLCFE through C++. Several simulation experiments based on three parameters, the Precision Ratio, the Recall Ratio and the Time Consumption, have been carried out respectively. Results show that FLCFE not only has good performances of the Recall Ratio and the Precision Ratio, but also has stable performance of time efficiency.

articleTitle: Pricing and Warranty Policy for Substitutable Products in the Channel with Dual Manufacturers and Single Retailer
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Pricing decisions and warranty period for two substitutable products in a supply chain with one common retailer and two competitive manufacturers are considered in this paper from a two-stage game theoretic. One centralized model and five decentralized models are established by considering the two manufacturers' cooperation/noncooperation strategies and the firms' identical bargain powers and the corresponding analytical equilibrium solutions are obtained by using game-theoretic approach. Finally, numerical studies are presented to illustrate the effectiveness of the theoretical results, and to gain additional managerial insights.

articleTitle: Image Denoising with an Adaptively Weighted Four-Directional Total Variation Method
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, an adaptively weighted four-directional total variation method (Ada-4WTV) is introduced to restore the image corrupted by additive Gaussian noise. In the Ada-4WTV, the trade-off parameter between regularization term and the data fidelity term is adaptive, which can help to deal with textures and smooth areas separately. What's more, four weights are designed in the TV regularization to preserve the textures and edges better. The boundary conditions are then also considered in the Ada-4WTV. Furthermore, the fast gradient projection (FGP) is extended to implement the Ada-4WTV. The experimental results indicate that the Ada-4WTV adapts to different noise levels and has better performance on keeping the image textures and edges.

articleTitle: A Method of Close Ultra-High Speed Infrared Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In 16Mb/s ultra-high speed infrared transmission mode, If we don't use special processing methods but directly make the common digital signal as the infrared transmission signal transmission, with a very high proportion of high level in the digital signal, the infrared emission tube will always in launching state, leading to higher transmission dissipation, it will also affect the life of infrared emitting tube at the same time, and the bit error rate is not effectively controlled in the direct transmission. In this paper, a method for the processing of a kind of near distance ultra-high speed infrared transmission signal is introduced. To deal with the infrared transmission signal through the method, it can reduce high level bit rate in the bit stream signal and increase the correlation between the bit, and the power consumption and signal transmission error rate is reduced. At the end of the paper, the feasibility of the method is proved by simulation and calculation.

articleTitle: An Improved CMAC Neural Network Model for Web Mining
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In recent years, the application of Web technology is more and more mature, and all manner of Web sites and search engines are distributed on the Internet resulting in a huge source of information. Thus, if the Web information is not well organized, it is hard to find the information what a user actually need or interest in. Automatic classification of Web pages is an efficient method in Web Content Mining which can be of great value in the management of Web directories. Based on the analysis done, The Cerebellar Model Articulation Controller (CMAC) is an excellent classification technique, but when it is applied to deal with high-dimensional dataset such as the data on the Internet, the memory required increase intensively. This paper presents an improved CMAC model used in content based Web page classification which requires less memory. The experimental results show that the proposed model is highly effective in Web page classification.

articleTitle: Analysis of 3GPP SAE Access Stratum Security Protocol
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The Safety streams of LTE/SAE system include AS (Access Stratum) and NAS (Non-Access Stratum) two security levels. The AS security is the security between the UE (User Equipment) and eNB (evolved Node-B), mainly to complete the encryption and integrity protection for AS signaling, the integrity protection for the data of UP (User Plane). In this paper, through the analysis of the SAE security architecture protocol, We describe the security access layer activation process and algorithm selection process, analyze the implementation algorithm of SAE access layer encryption and integrity mechanism. At the same time, it also introduces the common algorithm used in encryption and integrity protection algorithm-SNOW 3G algorithm, and the cost in terms of time and space of encryption and integrity protection algorithm are analysed.

articleTitle: Ant Colony Algorithm Study and Implementation Based on NS2
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Due to the small cycle, low cost, network simulation has become an important way of network research. As a widely used simulation software, NS2 have advantages of open source code and strong expansion. Ant colony algorithm is achieved on NS2, and the architecture and network protocol development process of NS2 is analyzed in this paper. For the slow search issue of parameter, the "Trilogy" rule will proposed to optimal it in this paper. The data will be generated by NS2 and the impact of the parameter (ant number, inspired factor, expectation inspired factor, and pheromone evaporation factor) on the algorithm will discussed and do many experiment to select the proper value for them. The jitter rate and packet transmission rate will used to verify the feasibility of the algorithm in this paper.

articleTitle: Dynamic Model Identification of the Super-Heated Steam Temperature for 300MW Circulating Fluidized Bed Boiler (CFBB)
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The dynamic model of 300MW CFBB super-heated steam temperature is established which takes the desuperheating water mass as the input and the inlet and outlet super-heated steam temperature as the output. Recursive least square (RLS) is used to identify the model parameters and the ideal identification result is achieved. The result provides a reference for the analysis and control of the dynamic characteristics of the 300MW CFBB.

articleTitle: Study on Boiler Combustion Optimization Based on Sparse Least Squares Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Under the background of seeking high efficiency and low nitrogen oxides (NOx) emissions for the boiler of power plants, this paper used least squares support vector machine (LSSVM) to model the boiler efficiency and NOx emissions of a power plant according to the experimental data acquired from a combustion adjustment test. A pruning algorithm based on active learning was applied to the combustion model built earlier to obtain a sparse LSSVM model. Compared to Suykens standard pruning algorithm for LSSVM, AL-LSSVM (active learning LSSVM) can significantly reduce the complexity of combustion models without degrading much, which provides an effective method for incremental or adaptive learning of combustion models.

articleTitle: Study of New Valued Tolerance Relation in Incomplete Information System
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The valued tolerance relation in the extension rough set model is studied and a new valued method is proposed in this article. The new method considers valued tolerance relation will be affected by the number and value of the known attributes, degree of correlation between known attributes and unknown attributes, and the similarity between the individual objects. A particular computing method is present and the characters of the new method are summarized. Also, we prove the method is reasonable by deduction and an instance.

articleTitle: Research on the Dynamic Simulation System in High Speed Machining of the Middle-Convex and Varying Ellipse Piston
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Through in-depth analysis of the fitting interpolation principle combining with characteristics of piston surface structure, the mathematical model of the type line fitting interpolation is established, which is applicable to vertical line and line of the different cross section shape. In order to improve the machining efficiency and precision, using modular design method and basing on the RAD Studio 2010, the dynamic simulation system of high speed machining of the middle-convex and varying ellipse piston is developed. The system can realize different structure piston dynamic simulation of the high speed machining process and generate the corresponding P code processing instructions by fitting interpolation model embedded in the system. Finally, the reliability of the system is verified by some examples. The experimental results show that the system is stable and reliable, with friendly interface and stronger versatility. It can effectively improve the accuracy and efficiency of various middle-convex and varying ellipse piston numerical control high speed machining.

articleTitle: Contrastive Analysis of Heuristic Algorithms for Covering Location Model of Traffic Patrol Police Deployment
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: According to whether the police resources have the maximum limit or not, the problem of traffic patrol police deployment is divided into two kinds: unlimited-resource and limited-resource problem, which could be solved by Set Covering Location Model and Maximum Covering Location Model respectively. In this paper, three heuristic algorithms, including Simulated Annealing Algorithm, Genetic Algorithm and Particle Swarm Optimization, are used to solve those models. Then part of the Beijing road network data is taken as an example to verify those algorithms. Finally, the advantages and disadvantages of those three algorithms are analyzed through contrasting the experimental result of those algorithms.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation for Wearability of the Germanium Fiber Seamless Underwear Fabrics
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This study blends the germanium fibers with the cottons, which are compared with bamboo charcoal fibers, then interweaves them with chinlons to improve the wearability. Setting"material", "mixed proportion" and "organizational structure" as the three factors, each of which includes three levels, and creates L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sub>(33) orthogonal experimental programs, tests the specifications and wear-abilities of the nine samples, evaluates the data comprehensively by using "gray optimal evaluation". The results show that when germanium fiber is blended with cotton and interwoven with chinlon with ratio of 35: 63, the performance of the final welt plain knitted fabric is the best.

articleTitle: Quantum Evolutionary Algorithm for Parallel Flowshop Scheduling Problem in Chemical Industry
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper studies the typical batching and scheduling problem of parallel flowshop, which is characterized by multi-product, multi-stage, parallel production, production coordination between stages, limit of equipment production capacity and inventory capacity, parallel equipment selection and limitation of batch quantity. This paper presents modified quantum evolutionary algorithm(MQEA) with continuous codes representing the batch size on the every stage to enhance the ability to handle constraints. The computational results show that the MQAE may find optimal or suboptimal solutions in a short run time for all the instances.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Interest Point Ranking and Valence-Arousal Tags of EEG Data
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The research on emotional tagging has always been an important issue in the field of Affective Computing. EEG signals are ideal to the analysis of affected rate because of its strong correlation and various information for the brain activities. However, EEG signals have its own complexity and noise, the choice of electrodes and frequency band needs evidence proof from experimental analysis. This paper aims to analyze EEG signals in the frequency domain and conduct analysis to reveal the important electrodes and frequencies. Later, correlation analysis on the result and the valence-arousal tagging is conducted. The paper's result will be useful for the feature selection problem the field of Affective Computing and the automation design for valence-arousal tagging as well.

articleTitle: Accuracy Optimization of UKF Algorithms in Mobile-Robot System
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Calculating Unscented Kalman Filter for each iteration of the filter should cost a lot of computing resources, which will delay the entire UKF compute cycles, and reduce the system timeliness. And also the Kalman Filter is easy to diverge. Improving the UT transform can reduce its computational complexity, and introducing attenuation factor can prevent the filter divergence. Finally, the simulation was validated.

articleTitle: A New Design of Wireless Transmission Coil
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper introduces a new design of a wireless transmission system with a coil printed in PCB. First, we understand the theory of the coil design, then show a well-designed wireless transmission system and its test results and optimization. Through optimization, the efficiency of the system can be improved. The results shows the experiment system can be applied in some situation which has demands on volume and cost.

articleTitle: Blind Image Restoration and Segmentation via Adaptive Norm Regularization and Mumford-Shah Edge Indicator
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper proposed a new model which can successfully solve the image restoration problem and segmentation together. In the new model, the blind image restoration and segmentation problem are decoupled, making the algorithm faster. The blind image restoration process is based on the adaptive norm regularization which can estimate both piecewise constant point spread function and smooth point spread function properly. The segmentation process is based on the explicit edge indicator function which is deduced by the Mumford-Shah model. The new model can be solved under Split Bregman iteration framework to accelerate the computation. Numerical experiments show that new algorithm produces the promising result and robust to noise.

articleTitle: Research on Weight Calculation for Requirement Indexes of Marine Shaft System Based on Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Pointed to the problem that fuzzy information was usually ignored in order to simplify Quality Function Deployment modeling process which make the decision deviate from scientific and reasonable result, fuzzy analytic hierarchy process was proposed to apply to weight calculation for requirement indexes of marine shaft system. Furthermore, construction method of fuzzy complementary matrix and weight vector defuzzification method for requirement indexes were deeply studied. Finally weight calculation of requirement indexes for a marine shaft system was studied as a case, which indicated that the method is feasible.

Author Keywords: Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process; Quality Function Deployment; Marine shaft system; Requirement indexes; Weight Calculation

articleTitle: Research on a Type of Camera Calibration Method Based on High Precision Detection of X Corners
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to meet the requirement of accurate and fast camera calibration, a method of high precision detection based on X corners is proposed. The 2-dimensional chessboard target is used as a template, in which, the sub-pixel coordinates of the X corners are extracted by using the Harris operator, so as to calculate the calibration parameters of the camera. The experiments show that this method has the advantages of short time consuming, simple operation and high precision, which is of important reference value in corner detection and camera calibration.

articleTitle: The Crawling Strategy of Shark-Search Algorithm Based on Multi Granularity
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Shark-search and HITS are the classical algorithms of subject crawler. Aiming at the phenomenon of the theme drift in HITS algorithm and the noise link in Shark-search algorithm, a new topic crawling strategy for improving Shark-search and HITS algorithm is proposed. Firstly, analyzed the depth of the web page and adopt the VIPS (vision-based page segmentation) block processing algorithm for a given web page. In the prediction of related links, adopt multi-granularity Shark-search algorithm, at the same time combined with HITS algorithm which depends on the query. This not only makes up for the lack of the Shark-search algorithm "global" problem, reduced the noise links, but also eliminated the HITS algorithm "subject drift" phenomenon. Experiments show that the new search strategy compared with the traditional strategy, the total query rate and query information has been further improved.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral Imagery Band Selection Based on Maximal Standard Deviation
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A new Hyperspectral image band selection algorithm based on maximal standard deviation is proposed to reduce spectral redundancy of Hyperspectral remote sensing image and computational complexity. It first uses standard deviation to measure the band information. The correlation between band and selecting band is then used as a weight factor for standard deviation in the iterative calculation. The experimental results show that the informative band subsets with low correlation can be selected using the maximal standard deviation. In addation, when the obtained bands are combined with Hyperspectral image classification, better classification accuracy can be produced.

articleTitle: Fault Intelligent Self-Healing System Modeling and Simulation for Mechanical and Electrical Equipment Based on Immune Principle
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In the study on fault self-healing of the signal disposal system of mechanical and electrical equipment, the mapping relationship of the fault self-healing system to the immune system is built up, based on the introduction of the immune principle and using the immune principle to self-healing. According to the mapping relationship, failure model of the self-healing system is established. The simulation of signal conditioning system's fault self-healing can prove the validity of this model and the feasibility of self-healing.

articleTitle: 3D Model Retrieval Based on Weighted Matching Point
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: As collections of 3D content grown rapidly, the ability to perform fast and accurate retrieval from a database of models or the Internet has become a necessity. This paper proposed a weighted matching point retrieval method of the 3D model according to the characteristics of the contour images of projected 3D models. This algorithm extracts SIFT features from the 2D projections of the 3D model, and then using the weighted parameters trained with SIFT to measure the similarity of 3D models. By comparing with the performance of ray-based method and D2 shape distribution method and Zernike moment method on the PSB, the experiment results show that the method is stable, and has better retrieval performance.

articleTitle: Study on Fault Prediction of Vehicles Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Arming at the complex electromagneter relationship of synchronous generator, it can work with wrong. Using wavelet packet transform to reduce voice, extracting the unsteady feature of the output voltage. According to LSSVM can make nonlinear prediction and HMM has the explanative ability, the fault prediction model based on LSSVM+HMM is presented., training the HMM by the normal features. Then the fault likelihood of unknown signal feature and the predicted feature calculated by LSSVM can be getted by the trained HMM. Decided the state of generator by comparing the values. Effectiveness of the model was verified from the real example.

articleTitle: Research on Gas Recognition Based on Stacked Denoising Autoencoders
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The gas data coming from an array of chemical gas sensors is a kind of multivariate time-series. This data set is extremely difficult and complex to interpret for human experts. It needs designing hand-made features when applying traditional shallow machine learning algorithms in gas recognition. A new gas recognition method based on Deep Learning were proposed in this paper. It is one of unsupervised feature learning methods that can extract self-adapting features from the gas data, overcoming the complex process in designing features by hands and making the features more general. In this work, two methods based on UCI Machine learning database respectively were compared in the experiments. One of them is a two-hidden-layer structure of deep neural network-Stacked denoising Autoencoders and another is a kind of shallow machine learning algorithms. The results show that extracting features automaticly using Deep Learning is a simpler and more universal way in gas recognition. The method proposed in this paper not only improves the gas classification accuracy, but also reduces complexity of the process in shallow machine learning alogithms, so it is valuable to be applied in practice.
